name: task-progress
description: Shows Claude's task list while it works: a side panel in Claude Desktop (with the other chats working right now), a progress line above the prompt in the terminal, and an optional Tasks sidebar for VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf or VSCodium (install it with /install-viewer).

placement.title: Where to show the task list
placement.description: auto = a side panel in Claude Desktop, one line above the prompt in the terminal. band = always the line above the prompt. pane = always the side panel. both = the panel and the line.
